Problem/Motivation

Spinning this off from side discussion on Slack from April 21st questioning the lack of CVE publication for disclosed CVE ID's

Currently there are a number of SA's that have a CVE ID's allocated, publicly and publicly disclosed however not published to the CVE registry.

CVE-2026-4093 - March 18th Published May 21st - ~62 days
CVE-2026-4929 - March 23rd Published May 21st - ~58 days
CVE-2026-5343 - April 1st
CVE-2026-6095 - April 8th Published May 19th - ~34 days
CVE-2026-6365 - April 15th Published May 19th - ~34 days
CVE-2026-6366 - April 15th Published May 19th - ~34 days
CVE-2026-6367 - April 15th Published May 19th - ~34 days
CVE-2026-6871- April 22nd Published May 19th - ~ 27 days
CVE-2026-6908 - April 23rd
CVE-2026-8491 - May 13th Published May 19th - ~6 Days
CVE-2026-8492 - May 13th Published May 19th - ~6 Days
CVE-2026-8493 - May 13th Published May 19th - ~6 Days
CVE-2026-8495 - May 13th
 Published May 19th - ~6 Days

As the Drupal Association and Drupal Security team are aware, or reasonably should be expected to be aware, the CVE program requires that CNA's publish to the registry within 72 hour of publicly disclosing an ID.

4.5.1.4 CNAs MUST publish a CVE Record to the CVE List within 72 hours of Publicly Disclosing a CVE ID assigned by the CNA.

https://www.cve.org/Resources/Roles/Cnas/CNA_Rules_v4.1.0.pdf

The CNA has not met this timeline for the above CVE ID's.

Additionally CNA rules encourage publication within 24 hours

4.5.1.3 CNAs SHOULD publish a CVE Record to the CVE List within 24 hours of Publicly Disclosing a CVE ID assigned by the CNA. CNAs MAY publish or update CVE Records as part of the CNA’s processes to manage Vulnerability advisories or other public information that references the CVE ID

https://www.cve.org/Resources/Roles/Cnas/CNA_Rules_v4.1.0.pdf

There has been some attempt to try and crowdsource this data in #3582693: Create CVEs for April and early May 2026. I maintain that without access to the security issues the community is not in a position to properly evaluate or create the data. Addtionaly the community are not Security Team members/Drupal CNA members, it is not their responsibility to generate this data.

Steps to reproduce

N/A

Proposed resolution

TBD by Drupal Association and Drupal CNA team.

Remaining tasks

Drupal Association/Drupal CNA team to develop plan for how to ensure publication within the mandatory 72 hour window and preferably within 24 hour window.

User interface changes

None

API changes

None

Data model changes

None

title: Plan for how to meet 72 hour publication obligation (CNAv4.1 section 4.5.1.4)
